placements.why: Nothing in the (empty) strata covers organizational infrastructure/technology decisions; this envelope's content — a database platform switch ratified by an engineering VP with a committed timeline — names an organizational category (system-level architecture decisions) that future envelopes about infrastructure choices will keep feeding, not a one-off fact.
placements.title: System infrastructure decisions become a standing organizational record
placements.frame: What underlying system, platform, or infrastructure choice is being made, and what does it commit the organization to going forward?

placements.title: Infrastructure moves from an incumbent system toward a purpose-built replacement
placements.frame: What system is being replaced, who ratifies the replacement, and by when is it committed to happen?
placements.why: src-1 is Dave Quantum's live declarative announcement of the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB switch and src-3 is its downstream summary restatement — conviction reads both as decision-grade, settled/ratified language (not argued-for claims), and relational/power reads both as authority-ranking, informational framing of an enacted transition. src-5's Q3 2026 timeline is the concrete execution commitment attached to that same ratified decision, not a separate recurring theme on its own — it belongs with the decision it dates. This is a subject (infrastructure replacement decisions and their commitments) future envelopes will keep feeding, not a single fact.

placements.title: Migration decisions get justified through quantified performance and cost claims
placements.frame: What quantified performance or cost benefit is offered to justify this migration, and does later evidence bear it out?
placements.why: src-2 (Dave Quantum's original '10x query performance, lower licensing cost' justification) and src-4 (Xena's summary restatement, '10x analytical queries') both perform the same market-pricing/rational-persuasion move — a quantified ROI-style benefit claim offered as the reason for the switch. Conviction marks both as unratified 'claim' language rather than 'decision' language, distinguishing this rationale theme from the settled decision itself; this is the kind of quantified justification pattern future migration envelopes will keep restating and testing against outcomes, not a one-time statistic.
